Alaska.Ai — Case File No. 2

2026-07-25 · branch claude/case-file-2026-07-25 · links pinned to the pushed commit

How to post this

1. Download the PDF and post it as a LinkedIn document post.
2. Document title, Case File No. 002, Two Rulers, One Exam Room
3. Paste the POST block as the caption. Nothing else goes in the post.
4. Paste the FIRST COMMENT block as your first comment right after posting.

The PDF

carousel.pdf · 6.38 MB, vector text

POST (paste as the caption, whole block)

A clinic network that owned its own software measured its AI scribe per visit. The independent study measured per week.

Carbon Health owned its own EHR and built the scribe inside it, for 600 plus clinicians by its own count. No outside party has audited those figures.

The peer reviewed study we used measured a different vendor's product, so it is category evidence, not company proof.

The deck walks through the build, the receipts, why the two numbers cannot be added, and the Alaska limits.

We do this kind of analysis for Alaska businesses, free. If you want your operation looked at this way, say the word.

What is the worst per unit number you have seen scaled into a business case?

#AmbientAI #ClinicOperations #AlaskaBusiness

FIRST COMMENT (paste right after posting)

Sources, primary first

1. Olson KD, Meeker D, Troup M, Barker TD, Nguyen VH, Manders JB, Stults CD, Jones VG, Shah SD, Shah T, Schwamm LH. Use of Ambient AI Scribes to Reduce Administrative Burden and Professional Burnout. JAMA Network Open, 2025, volume 8, issue 10, article e2534976. PEER REVIEWED, INDEPENDENT. It studied the Abridge ambient scribe, a different product from the one in this deck. https://jamanetwork.com/journals/jamanetworkopen/fullarticle/2839542

2. PubMed record for the same study, independent index. https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/41037268/

3. Dahal A, Skillman SM. Alaska's Physician Workforce in 2021. Center for Health Workforce Studies, University of Washington, July 2022, revised January 2025, HRSA funded. Every Alaska figure in the deck comes from here. https://familymedicine.uw.edu/chws/wp-content/uploads/sites/5/2022/08/Alaska_Physicians_FR_2022_July.pdf

4. Carbon Health, hands free charting announcement. COMPANY BLOG, SELF REPORTED. https://carbonhealth.com/blog-post/introducing-hands-free-charting-ai-enabled-note-taking-for-more-personal-visits

5. Carbon Health launches AI charting in its EHR. COMPANY PRESS RELEASE, NOT INDEPENDENT REPORTING. https://businesswire.com/news/home/20230605005211/en/Carbon-Health-Launches-AI-Charting-in-Its-EHR-Across-All-Clinics-and-Providers/

Disclosure. We could not independently verify a single Carbon Health figure this run. The trade coverage we went looking for returned an access error, so every company number in this deck is self reported and carries that label on the slide.

The rest of the Case Files sit at https://alaskaaihq.com if you want the earlier ones.

If you have run an ambient scribe, or any vendor pilot, in a clinic or anywhere else, add your own numbers or your war story below. Corrections welcome.

DO NOT POST THIS DECK WITHOUT READING IT YOURSELF. Scored 6.9 against the 7.7 four-plus-round threshold, capped by one hard fail, clipped and overlapping text on 7 of 10 slides from a single root cause, DOM labels positioned against canvas art with no bounds check. A targeted fix pass was applied to every named defect afterward and the machine gates now pass, but the deck was NOT re-scored and the case-critic was NOT re-run, so 6.9 stands as the last independently verified number. What the scorer praised, the writing, the sourcing discipline and the data-in-art are the best this machine has produced, and the argument that a per visit number cannot be budgeted as a per week result is a post nobody else on that feed has made. Three things to know beyond the score. First, there is ZERO independent corroboration of any Carbon Health figure this run, Becker's returned 403, so every company number ships vendor-labeled and the first comment discloses it. Second, the independent JAMA study measured Abridge, a different product, which the deck states twice. Third, the deck states no cost class or ramp anywhere, because no price was verifiable and the translation dossier refused to invent one, so CASE_CRAFT's WHAT IT TOOK beat is absent by decision, not by oversight.

Honesty gate

Verdict fix, all fixes applied, NOT re-verified. Weakest sentence under a hostile reply, "A peer reviewed study followed clinicians at 6 health systems for a year. CAUGHT AND FIXED, the study was a 30 day pre and post survey." (survives, True).

Bank health

13 ship-ready cases in the bank.

Aftercare

  • Post Tuesday to Thursday, 8 to 11am Alaska time. Drafts land daily and you own the cadence, so hold this one if a stronger deck is already queued.
  • Paste the first comment source block within about 60 seconds of posting, before the first readers arrive.
  • Reply substantively to every comment inside the first 90 minutes. A dead first hour rarely recovers.
  • At 48 hours, log saves against our trailing median and reply personally to anyone who took the offer line up.
